svg.title: Oleate-passivated CdSe/CdS core/shell QDs
svg.desc: CdSe/CdS names the inorganic core and shell. Oleate passivation is source-reported; ligand coverage, crystal phase and exact particle coordinates are unassigned. The starting QDs are inputs to patterning, not a complete growth recipe.
